items.title: New worm-like 'SCKit' malware targets MSPs in ScreenConnect attacks
items.snippet: A new worm-like malware toolkit named SCKit was deployed in the recent ScreenConnect attacks targeting managed service providers (MSPs), designed to spread from infected customer devices to MSP technicians' computers and compromise additional managed networks. [...]
items.summary: BleepingComputer reports SCKit malware was deployed in ScreenConnect attacks on MSPs and is designed to spread from customer devices to technicians’ computers and additional managed networks.
items.why: MSPs should check ScreenConnect environments and investigate potential spread between customer and technician devices.

items.title: Hackers compromise 4,800 GitHub accounts to steal cloud credentials
items.snippet: A new campaign dubbed 'wfx-loot' has unfolded on GitHub where threat actors used 4,837 compromised accounts to probe 61,764 repositories, open pull requests, and push secrets-stealing malware. [...]
items.summary: BleepingComputer reports the wfx-loot campaign used compromised GitHub accounts to probe repositories, open pull requests, and push malware that steals secrets.
items.why: Review GitHub account activity, pull requests, and repositories for unexpected changes or exposed secrets.

run_today: Check Microsoft service status and make alternate communications available during connectivity disruptions.
For MSP environments, review ScreenConnect activity and investigate unexpected connections between customer and technician devices.
Audit GitHub account activity, pull requests, and repositories for unexpected changes or secrets-stealing malware.

learn.explainer: Compromised accounts are accounts accessed or controlled by someone unauthorized. In the GitHub report, compromised accounts were used to probe repositories and push secrets-stealing malware.
Very-high-speed drones are uncrewed aircraft described by their high speed. Hermeus and Northrop Grumman say they are working toward bringing operational examples to the U.S. military.
Energy dependency is reliance on another country for energy. The report says a new power line has reduced Moldova’s dependence on Russia.

analysis.headline: Service Disruptions and Security Exposure Across Connected Systems
paragraphs: The Microsoft 365 outage and the Siemens security advisories in today’s top stories put service availability and system risk in focus. Microsoft says it is investigating connectivity problems across several services. The Siemens snippets point to security advisories, but provide too little detail to characterize the issues.

For defenders, the stories suggest checking both operational status and the security information available for systems in use. The outage may affect access to familiar work tools; the Siemens items call for attention to the underlying advisory details before deciding what action is appropriate. The supplied excerpts do not establish a connection between these events.

Analysts should watch for updates from Microsoft and further detail in the Siemens advisories, while keeping confirmed statements separate from open questions. The wider briefing also includes reports of malware targeting MSPs and GitHub accounts, reinforcing the value of reviewing access and unexpected changes without assuming those campaigns are linked to the top stories.
takeaways: Verify service status and maintain alternate communication options.
Review Siemens advisory details before assessing exposure.
Keep separate incidents distinct unless evidence connects them.
